name: CSV parser with quoting rules
instruction: Implement parseCSV(text) in csv.js returning an array of rows (each an array of string fields). It must handle quoted fields, commas inside quotes, escaped quotes ("" inside a quoted field becomes a single "), both LF and CRLF line endings, and a trailing newline (which must NOT produce an extra empty row). An in-repo test (test.js) is provided — run it with `node test.js` before finishing. Keep the CommonJS export shape.
